item.title: Taking Mario Kart 64 to Silverstone
item.description: I built Silverstone as a Mario Kart 64 course with GPT 6.1 Sol in Codex cloud environments, then used Max Verstappen’s pole lap onboard to shape the scenery, corner by corner.

item.title: Mario Kart 64 on My Phone: Giving the Agent a Test Drive
item.description: I brought Mario Kart 64 to my phone with WebAssembly, lighter textures and Tour-inspired controls, then gave the coding agent a way to test its changes before I played them myself.
